Teezy

Times are the course's local time. Prices are per golfer; Booking fees are shown wherever a booking system charges one. Where a course has its own booking site, times link there (GolfNow-only Hot Deals still go to GolfNow); "prepay online" means the rate must be paid when booking. Tap a time to book on the course's own site. Weather from Open-Meteo. Quiet / steady / packed is how many groups the course has sent out in the 90 minutes before that tee time, compared with how many its start interval allows. It's a tee-sheet estimate, not measured pace of play. Quality stars are GolfPass golfer reviews; ranking discounts small review counts. Youth on Course: $5 rounds for members ages 6–18 at participating courses during the hours shown; rules from youthoncourse.org.
